After browsing options online and in-store, we decided on Home Depot for carpet/flooring selection and installation services--and let me tell you, it was one of the best decisions we've made for our home. From start to finish, the process was straightforward, professional, and exceeded my expectations.First off, the selection at Home Depot is incredible, and competitively priced. The staff in the flooring department were knowledgeable and patient while assisting me without any high-pressure sales tactics. Scheduling the installation through their contractors, ACS Inc., was quick, easy and an overall happy experience. The schedulers were so helpful.Their team arrived right on time, were polite, efficient, and respectful of our home. The installation of both the carpet and the flooring was professional and flawless. No carpet seams showing, edges tucked perfectly, and the carpet stretched taut without a single wrinkle. The vinyl plank flooring was installed without any problems; the contractors handled the fitting of the planks with precision with zero gaps or uneven seams. If you're on the fence about big-box store services, I can confidently say this Home Depot experience was positive through and through--affordable, hassle-free, and worth every penny. Highly recommend Home Depot and their fabulous installers for anyone looking to upgrade their floors!The exact thing that I needed to purchase for the upcoming super snow storm they were out of. I guess the entire city of Woodbridge came here before I did to get the essential things they would need. I figured this was the case since the line to the self check out registers was sxrynpeople deep. I did manage to get two small extension cords, some duct tape, and other small screws that I needed to install shelving. This store was definitely bustling for a Saturday morning.
